editor.intro: Configure reusable notification content. Creating a template does not send a notification.
editor.name: Template name
editor.nameHint: For administrators; this is not the notification title.
editor.codeHint: Unique identifier used by integrations. Cannot be changed after creation.
editor.categoryPlaceholder: Select a category or enter a custom code
editor.categoryHint: Groups notifications and controls preferences. Coordinate custom codes with your integration.
editor.levelHint: Controls visual styling, not delivery priority.
editor.rawHint: Write text with placeholders such as {{variable}}. Your integration supplies the actual values when sending.
editor.i18nHint: Enter existing translation keys. Recipients see text in their interface language. Confirm translation resources with your developer first.
editor.modeLocked: Content mode cannot be changed after creation.
editor.insertEmpty: Add a variable below, then click its name to insert it.
editor.variablesEmpty: Leave empty for static text. Add variables for dynamic names, tasks, or other values.
editor.exampleHint: Examples are saved with the template for previews, not used as delivery defaults. Required variables must still be supplied when sending.
editor.jsonHint: Example: {{schema}}. type supports string, integer, number and boolean; required controls delivery validation; example is the saved preview value.
editor.schemaInvalid: Check variables: names must be unique and nonempty; JSON and each rule must be objects; type must be string / integer / number / boolean; required must be boolean; examples must match their selected types.
editor.previewTitleEmpty: Your notification title will appear here
editor.previewContentEmpty: Enter body text and example values to check the notification.
editor.previewHint: Preview uses example values and does not send notifications. Complex formatting must be verified by your integration.

previewIssues.undeclared: Variable {{name}} is not defined. Add it to the variable configuration.
previewIssues.missingExample: Enter an example for {{name}} to check its substituted value.
previewIssues.invalidExample: Example for {{name}} does not match its type. Use true / false for booleans.
previewIssues.unsupportedFormat: Cannot preview {{name}} locally. Use simple placeholders or verify complex formatting through your integration.
previewIssues.invalidFormat: Unbalanced braces in {{name}}. Fix the placeholder before saving.

editor.translationMissing: Translation not found in the current language: {{name}}. Showing the key instead.
editor.enabledHint: When disabled, integrations cannot send through this template.
editor.mandatoryHint: Bypasses category opt-outs without changing the audience. Enable only when necessary.
editor.reservedHint: This is a reserved system category. Users cannot opt out even when mandatory notifications are off.
editor.createHint: Creating or saving does not send notifications
editor.formInvalid: Check the required fields marked above.
editor.i18nInvalid: Invalid translation key. Use a key such as notification.taskCompleted.title and check both fields after switching modes.
editor.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your configuration and try again. Your entries have been kept.

previewSummary.invalidExample: Examples do not match their types: {{names}} (use true / false for booleans).
